# Sarah Chen — Director of Tutoring Programs

- **Relationship:** direct report; one of Cam's four directors. **Staff member — not a donor.**
  (Note: there is a separate major donor, [Sarah Whitman](sarah-whitman.md) — don't confuse them.)
- **Owns:** the [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md) across all
  6 school sites; manages the site coordinators and ~300 volunteer tutors, including lead tutor
  [Tasha Brooks](tasha-brooks.md).
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Mondays. Protective of her site coordinators' time during active weeks.

## What she cares about
- Keeping tutoring free and consistent for students; hates when funding uncertainty reaches staff.
- The [Hearthstone grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md) decline directly threatens her program
  budget — she is anxious about it and wants a plan, not just news.

## Notes
- Data-savvy for a program lead; tracks the grade-level-improvement outcome metric closely.
- Deeply loyal to the mission; came up as a volunteer tutor herself.
